Errors.NoPermission: You do not have permission to change the Immersive Scenes library.

StageAspect.Name: Stage aspect ratio
StageAspect.Hint: Shape of the stage frame that immersive scenes are composed in. It is centred on whatever battlemap is currently viewed.

AllowPlayerLooks.Name: Players can change looks
AllowPlayerLooks.Hint: Players may switch the look (outfit, armor, …) of characters they own. A GM must be online to apply the change.

AllowPlayerBorders.Name: Players can change borders
AllowPlayerBorders.Hint: Players may change the portrait border style and colors of characters they own.

FrameOnStart.Name: Frame the stage on broadcast
FrameOnStart.Hint: When a broadcast starts, every client's camera glides to show the whole stage. Everyone can pan and zoom freely afterwards.

ReduceMotion.Name: Reduce motion
ReduceMotion.Hint: Skip transitions and animated borders on this client. Also applies automatically in photosensitive mode or when your system prefers reduced motion.

BackgroundVolume.Name: Background video volume
BackgroundVolume.Hint: Volume multiplier for video backgrounds on this client.

AutoOpenDock.Name: Open the Live Dock on load
AutoOpenDock.Hint: GM only: open the Live Dock automatically when the world loads.

Warnings.NoCanvas: An immersive scene is live, but you are not viewing any scene, so there is no canvas to draw it on. View any scene to see it.
